subject: Steward knock + procurement map — Orchard Health follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchardhealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Steward knock + procurement map — Orchard Health follow-up

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery:

- Goal: reduce inference cost for batch claims processing and scale chat summarization for provider notes.
- Primary success criteria you called out: predictable per-token cost, <100ms median latency on short queries, and audit-ready logging for compliance.
- Technical constraints: existing SSO + SAML, on-prem data retention policy (90 days), and a SOC2 report requirement.

Two asks to keep momentum:
1) Can you confirm the budget owner/economic buyer we should loop in (name/title)? Ideally someone who signs PO + budget allocation.
2) Who owns procurement/legal review and the expected timeline for PO/contract approval (procurement contact, any standard SLAs or PO flow docs)?

If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute intro with that person + procurement this week — we’ll bring a one-slide ROI and a short Mutual Action Plan draft.

Proposed next steps (if you’re comfortable):
- You confirm name(s) for the budget owner and procurement contact.
- We schedule intro call (15–20 min).
- Redwood will share a two-column MAP and a sample SLA for your review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.ai>, Security <security@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 12:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steward knock + procurement map — Orchard Health follow-up

Aditya —

Good recap, thanks. Quick answers from my side:

- Budget owner / economic buyer: Sabrina Ortiz, VP Finance (sabrina.ortiz@orchardhealth.ai). She owns the program budget for data platform and third-party AI tooling.
- Procurement contact: procurement@orchardhealth.ai (lead: Karen Lu). They prefer receiving a one-page commercial summary + routing to PO.
- Security: please include security@orchardhealth.ai (secops lead is Mateo Rivas) for any SOC2 / logging details.
- Timeline: internal Q3 budget refresh; if we have a clear MAP and PO-ready commercial terms by mid-June, we can hit an August provisioning window.

I’m attaching the procurement flow we use internally — it outlines steps and expected reviewers. Also attaching current SLA template procurement asks for.

Attachment: Orchard_PO_Process_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 234 KB)
Attachment: SLA_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 45 KB)

Happy to intro Sabrina and Karen on a brief call — what times work for your team tomorrow or Friday?

—Daniel
Director, Data Platforms | Orchard Health
daniel.park@orchardhealth.ai | +1 (415) 555-4433

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Ortiz <sabrina.ortiz@orchardhealth.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchardhealth.ai>

Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steward knock + procurement map — Orchard Health follow-up

Thanks, Daniel — super helpful. Hi Sabrina (and Karen / Mateo), nice to e-meet. I’ll keep this short:

- Purpose: rapid intro to align on budget holder expectations, procurement gating items, and an outline MAP so financing + procurement know the delivery and sign-off milestones.
- Proposed 20-minute agenda: 1) 3–4 min ROI snapshot & pricing approach; 2) procurement route + required docs; 3) decision timeline & next steps.

Proposed times (PT):
- Fri 28 May, 11:00–11:20 AM PT
- Fri 28 May, 2:30–2:50 PM PT
- Mon 31 May, 9:00–9:20 AM PT

If none of those work I can send a Doodle — or, Daniel/Karen, feel free to propose preferred windows. We’ll also share a one-page commercial summary and the MAP link before the call.

Related: HubSpot deal 8427 (link below) has the forecasted ARR and product profile we discussed.
https://hubspot.company.com/deal/8427
https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD3KXzHqPqG7

Thanks — I’ll prepare the short MAP and a minimal SLA alignment doc for review.

Cheers,
